critical_limitation_notice: No public, ethically cleared dataset containing labelled Bangladeshi mobile-phone theft events currently exists. Therefore, Guardian AI does NOT train a phone-theft predictor or claim theft-prediction accuracy. All sensor models are strictly scoped to Device Activity/Context Classification (Task A) and Motion Anomaly Context Detection (Task B) as supplementary user-confirmed signals.

candidates_evaluated.name: UCI Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones (HAR)
candidates_evaluated.publisher: University of California Irvine Machine Learning Repository (Anguita et al.)
candidates_evaluated.licence: CC BY 4.0 / Academic Open Access (UCI ML Repository)
candidates_evaluated.features: 561 time- and frequency-domain features from embedded smartphone accelerometer and gyroscope (50Hz sampling, 2.56s sliding window).
candidates_evaluated.collection_method: 30 volunteers (ages 19-48) wearing waist-mounted Samsung Galaxy S II performing 6 activities.
candidates_evaluated.limitations: Controlled lab protocol, single device model, waist-mounted orientation, contains NO theft or snatching labels.
candidates_evaluated.relevance_to_guardian_ai: Selected for Task A (device activity/context classification) and Task B (unusual dynamic motion vs stationary baseline detection) with strict participant-aware splitting.

candidates_evaluated.name: WISDM Smartphone and Smartwatch Activity and Biometrics Dataset
candidates_evaluated.features: Raw 20Hz tri-axial accelerometer and gyroscope streams across 18 daily activities.
target_labels: 18 daily living activities (walking, jogging, stairs, sitting, standing, typing, etc.)
candidates_evaluated.collection_method: 51 subjects performing 18 activities for 3 minutes each.
candidates_evaluated.limitations: Raw time-series requires heavy windowing; no theft or snatching labels.
candidates_evaluated.relevance_to_guardian_ai: Evaluated as secondary candidate for future raw-stream windowing research.

candidates_evaluated.name: ExtraSensory Dataset
candidates_evaluated.features: In-the-wild smartphone sensor measurements + self-reported context labels.
target_labels: In-the-wild context tags (phone in pocket, walking, on table, etc.)
candidates_evaluated.limitations: Large size, missing sensor modalities per sample, self-reported label noise, no theft labels.
candidates_evaluated.relevance_to_guardian_ai: Useful context reference for pocket vs table placement, but lacks theft labels.
